The '''Kwenn system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was situated along the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. The Kwenn system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kwenn/Legends|Kwenn]], which was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]].
